algorithm: CatBoost log Huber delta=0.2 residual top25% per phase
rule: Exactly ceil(25% of each original phase), ranked by absolute log observed/predicted residual; deterministic row_id tie break. Original training uses 3-fold OOF; validation/test use a training-only cleaner. No OutlierTree/IsolationForest union.

selection_imr.reason: The supplied wholesale dataset contains only reported sold vehicles. No same-market sold/unsold total listing population is available. Craigslist asking listings are not fabricated auction non-sales.
selection_imr.scope: cleaning model only; never a feature of the final Huber model

warning: Requested top-25% absolute log-residual filtering also uses validation/test outcomes. Filtered metrics are optimistic selected-cohort results, not generalization estimates. Original unfiltered-test diagnostics use a previously examined benchmark; a fresh external test is needed. Assessment weights fit retained training only; deployment is a separate refit on all retained phases.
